edges.rationale: Both are light-armor agility-based characters with dark earthy color palettes and stealthy ranger aesthetics; both are female-presenting with concealed or understated gear
Both are female characters in earthy-toned light armor with nature-adjacent aesthetics and shared warm sepia/brown palette
Both are elderly male spellcasters with long white hair and beards, holding magical staves, wearing elaborate robes with arcane accessories; archmage is the elder/master tier of the mage archetype
Both are heavy plate armor wearing male warriors with heraldic/holy emblems; knight carries lion heraldry while paladin carries solar holy symbol; both serve frontline tanking roles
Both share supportive/holy role archetypes — paladin as divine warrior-healer and healer as nature-based support; complementary support roles in a party composition
Both are melee-focused male warriors though stylistically opposite — barbarian is primal/unarmored while knight is disciplined/fully armored; both serve frontline combat roles
Both share very dark, gritty illustration tone and are melee-combat focused characters; assassin's olive-dark palette echoes barbarian's earthy tones
Both radiate supernatural power through luminous visual effects — archmage via magical orbs and fire, paladin via divine golden armor and holy emblem; both convey mastery-tier characters

Both are hero portrait images from the same game (Horizon Forge) sharing identical visual style: hand-drawn ink illustration on aged parchment background, same portrait dimensions, same artistic treatment
Both are hero portrait images from the same game sharing identical parchment-textured background and hand-drawn illustration style
Both are hero portrait images from Horizon Forge with shared parchment background visual style
Both are hero portrait images from Horizon Forge with shared parchment background and hand-drawn illustration style

hyperedges.label: Horizon Forge Hero Portrait Set - Shared Visual Style
hyperedges.rationale: All 8 hero portraits share a unified visual style: hand-drawn ink illustration rendered over aged warm parchment/yellowed paper background, consistent portrait framing (bust to waist), warm sepia undertones throughout, same artistic medium and level of detail, and game-consistent character design language for Horizon Forge

hyperedges.label: Arcane / Magic User Character Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: Archmage and Mage are both elderly male spellcasters with long white hair, magical staves, elaborate arcane robes and accessories; they form the dedicated arcane caster archetype group

hyperedges.label: Heavy Armored Warrior Character Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: Knight and Paladin both wear full plate armor with heraldic/holy emblems, carrying shields or warhammers; both are male frontline heavy combatants with nobility aesthetic

hyperedges.label: Female Light Armor Character Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: Archer and Healer are both female characters in light earthy-toned armor with nature-adjacent aesthetics, approachable expressions, and shared warm brown/olive color palettes
